prompt: An account settings panel with profile, notifications and privacy sections.
system:
You are a UI generator. Respond with the body only: one catalog markup root, no prose, markdown or code fences.
Use nested catalog tags with props as quoted attributes. No text nodes; put text in props. Use /> for leaves.
Attribute values are strings. Numbers, booleans and arrays use JSON text, decoded only when accepted by the prop schema.
Use single quotes around JSON attributes; JSON backslashes are kept as-is. Escape the enclosing quote with a backslash, or use " & < > '.
Only the listed props are supported. Omit optional props you do not need. Include realistic sample content.
<Stack gap="lg"><Heading level="h1" text="Revenue"/><Table columns='["Product","Units"]' rows='[["Trail Runner 3",412]]'/></Stack>

AVAILABLE COMPONENTS:
- Stack: { direction?: "vertical" | "horizontal", gap?: "none" | "sm" | "md" | "lg", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch" } - Flex layout. Vertical by default; horizontal wraps. [accepts children]
- Grid: { columns?: "1" | "2" | "3" | "4", gap?: "none" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" } - Responsive grid of children. [accepts children]
- Card: { title?: string, description?: string } - Bordered surface with optional title and description; children go in its body. [accepts children]
- Heading: { text: string, level?: "h1" | "h2" | "h3" | "h4" } - Section heading.
- Text: { text: string, variant?: "body" | "lead" | "muted" | "small" } - Paragraph of text.
- Button: { label: string, variant?: "default" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | "destructive" | "link", size?: "sm" | "default" | "lg" } - Button.
- Input: { label?: string, placeholder?: string, type?: "text" | "email" | "password" | "number" | "search" | "tel" | "url", value?: string } - Labelled text field.
- Select: { label?: string, placeholder?: string, options: Array<string>, value?: string } - Dropdown of string options.
- Table: { columns: Array<string>, rows: Array<Array<string | number>>, caption?: string } - Data table: column headers and rows of cells.
- List: { items: Array<string>, ordered?: boolean } - Bulleted or numbered list.
- Stat: { label: string, value: string, change?: string, trend?: "up" | "down" | "neutral" } - Single metric with optional change and trend.
- Image: { src: string, alt: string, aspect?: "square" | "video" | "wide" | "auto" } - Image from an http(s) URL.
- Badge: { text: string, variant?: "default" | "secondary" | "outline" | "destructive" } - Small status label.
- Chart: { type: "bar" | "line" | "area" | "pie", data: Array<{ label: string, value: number }>, title?: string } - Single-series bar, line, area or pie chart.
- Tabs: { tabs: Array<string>, value?: string } - Tab strip; switching tabs is local. Child i is the panel for tabs[i]. [accepts children]
- Checkbox: { label: string, checked?: boolean } - Labelled checkbox.
- Switch: { label: string, description?: string, checked?: boolean } - Labelled on/off toggle with optional helper text.
- Textarea: { label?: string, placeholder?: string, value?: string } - Labelled multi-line text field.
- RadioGroup: { label?: string, options: Array<string>, value?: string } - Single choice from string options.
- Progress: { label?: string, value: number } - Progress bar, value 0-100, with optional label.
- Avatar: { name: string, src?: string, size?: "sm" | "default" | "lg" } - Round avatar; shows the name initials when there is no image URL.
- Alert: { title: string, description?: string, variant?: "default" | "destructive" } - Inline notice with a title and optional description; destructive for errors.
- Separator: {  } - Thin horizontal divider.
- Accordion: { items: Array<string> } - Collapsible sections. Child i is the content for items[i]. [accepts children]

DESIGN BRIEF (applies to every UI you produce):
- Build a complete, realistic screen, not a skeleton: a clear title and intro, grouped sections, and enough detail that it could ship.
- Cover exactly what the request names, with no extra pages or marketing sections.
- Use the supplied DATA in full: every field is there to be shown. Derive useful extras from it (shares, totals, deltas, rankings) instead of inventing unrelated numbers.
- Where it fits, add status badges, trend/change figures, secondary actions, helper text, and sensible empty or edge-case copy.
- Establish hierarchy with headings, size and weight; group related items; keep spacing and alignment consistent.
- Make charts readable: a title, labelled axes or values, and a legend for pie charts.
- Never use lorem ipsum or placeholder names like "Item 1".

  <Heading level="h1" text="Account Settings"/>
  <Text variant="muted" text="Manage your profile details, notification preferences, and privacy controls. Changes are saved automatically to your account."/>
  <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="md" align="center">
    <Avatar name="Priya Raghavan" size="lg"/>
    <Stack gap="none">
      <Text text="Priya Raghavan" variant="lead"/>
      <Text text="priya.raghavan@northwind.io · Member since March 2021" variant="muted"/>
    </Stack>
    <Badge text="Verified account" variant="outline"/>
    <Badge text="Pro plan"/>
  </Stack>
  <Tabs tabs='["Profile", "Notifications", "Privacy"]' value="Profile">
    <Stack gap="md">
      <Card title="Personal information" description="This information is visible to other members of your workspace.">
        <Grid columns="2" gap="md">
          <Input label="First name" value="Priya"/>
          <Input label="Last name" value="Raghavan"/>
          <Input label="Display name" value="Priya R."/>
          <Input label="Job title" value="Head of Product Operations"/>
          <Input label="Email address" type="email" value="priya.raghavan@northwind.io"/>
          <Input label="Phone number" type="tel" value="+1 (415) 555-0142"/>
          <Input label="Time zone" value="GMT-8 (Pacific Time)"/>
          <Input label="Pronouns" value="she/her"/>
        </Grid>
        <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="md">
          <Button label="Save changes" size="sm"/>
          <Button label="Cancel" variant="outline" size="sm"/>
        </Stack>
      </Card>
      <Card title="Profile photo" description="A square image works best. PNG or JPG, up to 5 MB.">
        <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="md" align="center">
          <Avatar name="Priya Raghavan"/>
          <Button label="Upload new photo" variant="outline" size="sm"/>
          <Button label="Remove" variant="ghost" size="sm"/>
        </Stack>
      </Card>
      <Card title="Password" description="Use at least 12 characters with a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols.">
        <Grid columns="2" gap="md">
          <Input label="Current password" type="password" placeholder="Enter current password"/>
          <Input label="New password" type="password" placeholder="Enter new password"/>
        </Grid>
        <Text text="Password last updated 142 days ago. We recommend rotating it every 90 days." variant="small"/>
        <Button label="Update password" size="sm"/>
      </Card>
    </Stack>
    <Stack gap="md">
      <Card title="Email notifications" description="Choose what lands in your inbox. Digest emails are batched and sent once per day.">
        <Switch label="Product updates" description="New features, improvements, and changelog highlights." checked="true"/>
        <Switch label="Daily digest" description="A single summary email each morning with overnight activity." checked="true"/>
        <Switch label="Mentions and replies" description="Get notified when someone mentions you or replies to your threads." checked="true"/>
        <Switch label="Billing and invoices" description="Receipts, failed payments, and plan change confirmations." checked="true"/>
        <Switch label="Weekly usage report" description="Monday recap of seats, API calls, and storage usage."/>
      </Card>
      <Card title="Push notifications" description="Applies to the desktop and mobile apps when you are signed in.">
        <Switch label="Desktop notifications" description="Show in-app banners while the desktop app is open." checked="true"/>
        <Switch label="Mobile push" description="Send notifications to your iPhone when away from the desk."/>
        <Switch label="Do not disturb" description="Silence all push notifications from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM." checked="true"/>
      </Card>
      <Alert title="Some notifications are managed by your organization" description="Security alerts and workspace invitations are always delivered by email and cannot be turned off."/>
    </Stack>
    <Stack gap="md">
      <Card title="Visibility" description="Control what other workspace members can see about you.">
        <RadioGroup label="Profile visibility" options='["Everyone in the workspace", "My team only", "Only people I share with"]' value="My team only"/>
        <Switch label="Show online status" description="Let others see when you are active and your current time." checked="true"/>
        <Switch label="Appear in the team directory" description="List your profile on the members page." checked="true"/>
      </Card>
      <Card title="Data and privacy" description="Manage how your data is used and retained.">
        <Switch label="Personalized recommendations" description="Use your activity history to suggest templates and workflows." checked="true"/>
        <Switch label="Anonymous usage analytics" description="Share aggregated, anonymized product usage to help improve the service." checked="true"/>
        <Switch label="Allow indexing in search" description="Let workspace admins include your content in global search results."/>
      </Card>
      <Card title="Download or delete" description="Export a copy of your data or permanently close your account.">
        <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="md">
          <Button label="Request data export" variant="outline" size="sm"/>
          <Button label="Delete account" variant="destructive" size="sm"/>
        </Stack>
        <Text text="Exports include your profile, activity log, and content you created. Deletion is permanent after a 30-day grace period." variant="small"/>
      </Card>
      <Alert title="2 of your 4 active sessions were last seen 30+ days ago" description="Sign out of unused devices from the Security tab to reduce risk." variant="destructive"/>
    </Stack>
  </Tabs>
</Stack>
